source_evidence: Leveraged loans typically have a long settlement period, meaning it could take the fund a long time to get its money after selling its investment.
question: Why can leveraged loans’ long settlement periods create a liquidity risk for a fund?
answer: If a fund needs to sell leveraged loans quickly, it may have to wait a long time to receive the proceeds. This can be especially challenging when the fund holds many such loans and may affect the value of your investment.
